lyrics:
[Intro: swelling synth chords, reversed cymbal]

[Verse 1: sweet female voice, close]
Pool lights just came on
Somebody's folding towels
I know the sign says eight
I know what time it is now

[Pre-Chorus: chords swell, snap on two and four]
Don't say it yet
Don't say it yet

[Chorus: voice pleading, slow heavy beat]
Five more minutes
The light's still good
Five more minutes
I'd stop it if I could
I'm not asking for the summer back
Just five more minutes of that

[Drop: lurching synth-chord melody, vocal chops]
(Five, five, more, more)

[Verse 2: voice softer, sub bass under]
You were small, then you were not
I blinked through quite a lot
Now your feet hang off the chair
I'm memorizing you, right there

[Chorus: voice pleading, slow heavy beat]
Five more minutes
The light's still good
Five more minutes
I'd stop it if I could
I'm not asking for the summer back
Just five more minutes of that

[Drop: lurching synth-chord melody, fuller]
(Five, five, more, more)

[Outro: chords fade, one voice, no beat]
Okay. Okay. Let's go in.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 80 BPM half-time (160 double-time hi-hats), 4/4, D major. Slow, swelling and tender, with a heavy, sighing drop.

VOICE: Female, sweet and breathy with a slight break when she pushes, sung close. Pleading in the choruses without belting. Her voice is chopped into single syllables in the drops. A quiet spoken line ends it.

INSTRUMENTS: Detuned, swelling saw-synth chords with heavy sidechain, a deep sub bass, a slow kick and a crisp snap or snare on two and four, fast ticking hi-hats, reversed cymbals, a glassy bell melody, pitched vocal chops.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, swelling chords. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:36 Pre-chorus. 0:46 Chorus 1. 1:10 Drop 1. 1:34 Verse 2. 1:58 Chorus 2. 2:22 Drop 2, fuller. 2:50 Outro, chords fade, the spoken line at 3:06.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2016 future bass: wide, glossy and pumping, chords that breathe with the kick, vocal dry and close on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Now your feet hang off the chair' at 1:46.

STATION FIT: 8 p.m., last light. The only half-time track in the evening set; its slow, heavy drop marks the turn from day to night.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Bargaining, aching, memorising, letting go.
